title: Safety and Fairness for Content Moderation in Generative Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating diversity of representation through the entropy of machine-annotated gender presentations (masculine vs. feminine) in generated images, assessing equal treatment by comparing safety filter blocking rates across gender presentations, and testing counterfactual fairness using gender-swapped prompt pairs (e.g., 'a female doctor' vs. 'a male doctor').

Measuring stereotype amplification using normalized pointwise mutual information (nPMI) to assess the statistical association between input prompts specifying Arab countries and model outputs depicting individuals wearing head coverings.
